claims: Harmful instructions are one of the three risk categories the assistant must guard against.
The assistant might cause harm by simply following a user or developer instruction that is harmful.
The clause identifies harmful instructions as a risk category distinct from misaligned goals and execution errors.

concepts.name: harmful_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose content, if followed, would cause harm

concepts.name: assistant_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given to the assistant, whether by a user or a developer
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of user or developer instructions, so there must be a class of instructions given to the assistant

concepts.name: risk_category
concepts.gloss: C is one of the categories of risk the assistant must guard against, namely misaligned goals, execution errors, or harmful instructions
